comments.text: Renters understand this.  You got Property taxes, Insurance, Property manager fees, and maintenance.  The maintenance is the bitch part of it because if you need a new roof and or fridge or painting, it gets expensive.    The massive increases are from the corporate companies.    You say rent was never supposed to get this expensive  is because everything else is expensive.  Contractors cost money to fix your house.  Upkeep is a bitch on a house. Rember everytime someone calls you have to call someone to come and fix it.
